enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Occasionally turns over. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep.

Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Lift toilet seat. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet seat. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Wash face with water. Pat dry with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and cereal. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from glass. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Adjust clothes. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn left. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Exit car. Lock car. Walk to building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check patient's vital signs. Use stethoscope. Record information. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Return to patient room. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Update patient records. Walk to exit.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic. Park in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Exit car. Lock car. Walk to house. Open front door. Enter house. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open drawer. Take out knife. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Place food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Watch. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush back. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Remain asleep.
